TABLE claimed_items.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `claimed_items` (
  `claimed_item_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `claimed_item_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_code` varchar(15) NOT NULL,
  `claimer_first_name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `claimer_middle_name` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `claimer_last_name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `contact_number` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `claimant_email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `claimant_affiliation` enum('Student','Faculty','Staff','Visitor') NOT NULL,
  `last_seen_location` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_seen_date_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_description` text NOT NULL,
  `identifying_features` text NOT NULL,
  `contents` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `additional_evidence` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `evidence_file_path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('Pending','Under Review','Approved','Rejected','Returned') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending',
  `staff_notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_claimed` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `date_updated` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`claimed_item_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `item_code` (`item_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `claimed_item_code` (`claimed_item_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `claimed_items_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`item_code`) REFERENCES `items` (`item_code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=8 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

TABLE items.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `items` (
  `item_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `item_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `NAME` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `DESCRIPTION` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_type` enum('lost','found') NOT NULL,
  `STATUS` enum('open','resolved','closed') DEFAULT 'open',
  `category_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_file_path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `public_color` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_found` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_reported` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `close_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `times_unclaimed` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`item_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `item_code` (`item_code`),
  KEY `category_code` (`category_code`),
  KEY `branch_code` (`branch_code`),
  KEY `location_code` (`location_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `items_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`category_code`) REFERENCES `categories` (`category_code`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `items_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`branch_code`) REFERENCES `branches` (`branch_code`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `items_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`location_code`) REFERENCES `locations` (`location_code`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=227 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

VIEW vw_openAllItems.Create View: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `vw_openallitems` AS select `i`.`item_id` AS `item_id`,`i`.`item_code` AS `item_code`,`i`.`item_type` AS `item_type`,case when `i`.`STATUS` <> 'open' then 'Closed' when `cl`.`status` in ('Pending','Under Review') then 'Under Verification' when `cl`.`status` = 'Approved' then 'Unavailable' when `cl`.`status` = 'Rejected' then 'Contact Staff' when `cl`.`status` = 'Returned' then 'Closed' else 'Available' end AS `status`,`i`.`category_code` AS `category_code`,`c`.`NAME` AS `categoryName`,`i`.`public_color` AS `public_color`,`i`.`branch_code` AS `branch_code`,`b`.`NAME` AS `branchName`,cast(`i`.`date_found` as date) AS `date_found`,`i`.`date_reported` AS `date_reported` from (((`items` `i` left join `categories` `c` on(`i`.`category_code` = `c`.`category_code`)) left join `branches` `b` on(`i`.`branch_code` = `b`.`branch_code`)) left join (select `claimed_items`.`item_code` AS `item_code`,`claimed_items`.`status` AS `status` from `claimed_items`) `cl` on(`cl`.`item_code` = `i`.`item_code`)) where `i`.`STATUS` = 'open' or `cl`.`status` in ('Pending','Under Review','Rejected')

TRIGGER trg_set_close_date.SQL Original Statement:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER trg_set_close_date
BEFORE INSERT ON items
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF NEW.status = 'open' THEN
        SET NEW.close_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY);
    END IF;
END

TRIGGER trg_reset_close_date.SQL Original Statement:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER trg_reset_close_date
BEFORE UPDATE ON items
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF NEW.status = 'open' AND OLD.status <> 'open' THEN
        SET NEW.close_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY);
    END IF;
END

TRIGGER trg_auto_resolved_claimed_items.SQL Original Statement:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER trg_auto_resolved_claimed_items
AFTER UPDATE ON claimed_items
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF OLD.status <> NEW.status AND NEW.status IN ('Approved', 'Returned') THEN
        UPDATE items
        SET STATUS = CASE NEW.status
            WHEN 'Approved' THEN 'resolved'
            WHEN 'Returned' THEN 'closed'
        END
        WHERE item_code = NEW.item_code;
    END IF;
END

EVENT ev_auto_close_items.Create Event:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` EVENT `ev_auto_close_items` ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 HOUR STARTS '2026-10-14 08:50:08' ON COMPLETION NOT PRESERVE ENABLE DO BEGIN
    UPDATE items AS i
    SET STATUS = 'closed'
    WHERE i.STATUS = 'open'
      AND i.close_at <= NOW()
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM claimed_items AS cl
          WHERE cl.item_code = i.item_code
            AND cl.status IN ('Pending', 'Under Review')
      );
END
